messages:
Marie: Heads-up — planning a short access review next Tue-Wed for infra + payments admin roles. Goal is a lightweight entitlement declutter: revoke console/KMS grants inactive >90d and confirm owners for any role with >5 members. 48h notice, dry run first via AccessBot. Thoughts?
Alex: +1 from infra. can we exempt the oncall rotation roles? those will look inactive sometimes. :+1:
Julia: Agree with Alex. Also would like an impact column so product teams can triage quickly if someone's removed. Maybe include a fallback SRE contact per role.
David: I can run the initial owner-query and KMS sweep. Quick query I usually start with:
```sql
SELECT role, principal, last_active
FROM rbac_bindings
WHERE last_active < now() - interval '90 days'
  AND role ILIKE 'admin%';
```
I'll post results as CSV to this thread.
AccessBot: dry run scheduled by Marie for 2026-03-30T09:00Z. Will post flagged bindings and KMS grant summary in-thread when complete.
Sarah: Please include cross-account KMS grants — those are the usual surprise. Also flag any grants that have "ExternalPrincipal" in the principal field.
Ben: Suggest we add a quick escalation play: if owner not found within 72h, auto-apply a temp-disable label and notify product security. Keeps blast small.
Marie: Good call Ben. We'll do: 1) dry run, 2) owner ping email + slack attestation, 3) 72h owner remediation window, 4) auto-disable if unresolved, with rollback runbook.
Alex: One more ask — can we exclude roles tagged with `business-critical=true`? Those should get manual review.
David: I'll add those filters. Also will include KMS check snippet I use for AWS: 
```bash
# list grants older than 90d for a given key
aws kms list-grants --key-id $KEY_ID --query "Grants[?CreateTime<\`$(date -d '90 days ago' --iso-8601=seconds)\`]"
```
Not perfect but narrows noise.
AccessBot: dry run complete — 58 bindings flagged, 19 KMS grants older than 90d, 7 roles exceed 5 members, 12 principals tagged ExternalPrincipal. CSV uploaded: https://redwood.internal/s/entitlement-dryrun/4991234567.csv
Julia: Nice. I'll help triage the top 10 high-risk ones (payments infra + cross-account).
Sarah: I'll take the KMS grants list and map to key owners.
Marie: Action items: David posts final CSV to #incidents; Julia triages top 10; Sarah maps KMS owners; Ben finalizes rollback playbook. I'll draft the owner ping message and tag product leads. Plan to start remediation Wed morning after the 48h notice window. :calendar:
Alex: Sounds good. FYI I'll coordinate exclusion for oncall roles and add the `business-critical=true` exemption to the script.
David: Uploading CSV now and adding filters. Will follow up in this thread with a short remediation timeline.
Marie: thanks everyone — keeping this low-blast but thorough. ping me if you see anything that needs to be escalated before Wed. :wave:
